items.title: Populated inbox composer simplification
items.precondition: Prepare an account with at least one conversation and an account with no conversations.
steps: Open /messages and wait for conversations to load.
For the populated inbox, confirm no NEW MESSAGE heading or compose block appears above Conversations.
Select the person-plus toolbar icon labelled New message; confirm the friend search opens and receives focus.
Search for a friend (including one with an existing conversation), close with Escape and the Close search button, and confirm focus returns to the New message trigger.
Open a friend and confirm navigation still works.
Confirm the gear remains Message settings and the person-plus icon no longer routes to Manage friends.
For the empty inbox, confirm the Friends heading and friend search remain available.
Simulate or observe a failed mutual-friends request from a populated inbox and confirm its error remains visible.
items.expected: The person-plus icon is always an accessible New message trigger; it opens the searchable friend picker from every inbox state. A closed populated inbox remains compact, while empty and error states remain visible.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: user confirmed live acceptance A1. Root typecheck and production build pass after the controlled picker handoff; frontend lint completes with unrelated pre-existing warnings in AuthContext, ThemeContext, MessageQuoteStrip, PostPhotoCommentsPage, and PostDetailPage.
items.notes: Live acceptance completed by the user.
